queries.query: Biu Nigeria cadastral parcel map official land registry GIS; Nigeria official cadastral map parcel service Biu Borno land registry GIS
queries.result: Found the first-party Borno State Geographic Information Service (BOGIS) site and application portal, plus Borno land-use regulations. BOGIS is the state land-administration custodian and its regulations describe the official digital repository and Cadastral Administration System, but no public anonymous Biu parcel vector response was exposed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: BOGIS states that it administers land matters in Borno State, maintains a land-related digital repository, and operates a Cadastral Administration System; the regulations state that the repository includes land-use cadastre and that BOGIS maps/data are official.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The BOGIS custodian and documented state-level cadastre scope are verified, but Biu-specific parcel coverage and anonymous parcel geometry access are not verified.

technicalBlocker: The public BOGIS information site exposed institutional/procedural material but no map API. The current app portal loaded anonymously as an application landing page; GET https://app.bogis.bornostate.gov.ng/api/properties and GET https://app.bogis.bornostate.gov.ng/api/map both returned HTTP 404. No public viewer JavaScript/configuration identified a safe parcel layer or feature route.
remainingUncertainty: BOGIS may hold Biu cadastral records behind its authenticated or fee-based workflow, or in an unadvertised internal service. A zero exact-point result was not used and the immutable WUP point was not shifted; no citywide absence is inferred.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently qualify any current anonymous BOGIS map/vector route and native parcel identity, if one becomes discoverable, using only safe ID+geometry fields and the unchanged WUP point for bounded checks.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged WUP 2025 settlement point (latitude, longitude); not shifted to force a parcel hit.
registryBasis: BOGIS is the evidenced Borno State local land-administration and cadastral custodian; its official site states responsibility for title, registration, searches, and a state land database, while the 2022 regulations define the official digital repository and CAS.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No safe public source-native parcel polygon with stable native ID was verified.
